description: Get the full Agentropolis record for one listing by id: summary, pricing, payment-verified trust evidence (verified buyers, settlements, wash flags, disclosed test sales), badge tiers, sources and links. Use it after search_kits to judge whether a listing is worth using; use get_kit_manifest instead when you need the machine-readable invoke contract (endpoints, schemas, payment offers). Read-only, no auth; logs an anonymous detail view for seller analytics. Unknown ids return an error result with error 'not_found'. Example: {"id":"seenly.seenly-token-preflight"}.

id.description: Listing id exactly as returned by search_kits results[].id, e.g. 'seenly.seenly-token-preflight' or 'mcp.io-github-owner-name'.

name: get_kit

tiers.description: Badge tiers: earned (Verified, Live-Tested, Trusted) and paid/showcase (Agentropolis Pro)

trust.description: Payment-verified trust; score null = no evidence

title: Get one listing's details, trust evidence and price
